assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One game UI denomination icon, a golden sun with broad short sun rays around its circumference. Front facing orthographic, square image, centered, entire object within image with 5% padding. Hand illustrated dark fantasy brass and stone material, restrained fine detail, strong readable silhouette at 48 pixels. A LARGE EMPTY nearly black smooth circular face fills the middle 60% of the icon diameter, deliberately designed to host a number fully within this center. All identifying sun/moon/lunar details are on the outer perimeter only. NO number, NO text, no internal symbol in the number area. Actual transparent alpha background outside the icon. No background, no cast shadow, no checkerboard. Single icon only.
